stages.name: Setup — before you start
stages.text: Turn cheats off: PowerPyx reports that a cheat disables trophies (and you cannot save afterwards). Decide how you feel about spoilers and set the spoiler toggle in the Tracker — story trophies stay hidden until earned. Start a manual save habit now: one save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission, because GTA VI has no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
tips: Cheats off, always
Manual save at the start of every chapter
Set the spoiler toggle to taste

stages.name: Story — Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale
stages.text: Play the story straight through at your leisure. Every chapter and mission trophy unlocks by finishing: Gone Fishing, the four chapters, the final mission, and the named missions (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory). Two things to do on the way: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate (see Missables); and in Chapter 3, save before the time-sensitive Race Against Yago.
tips: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation
Save before Race Against Yago (Chapter 3)
Keep a save before the final mission

stages.name: Questlines — stranger strands
stages.text: After the story, or alongside it, run the stranger strands to their ends: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus the other strangers across Leonida. Eight finished strands earn Strangers & Freaks, and each strand's final mission is its own trophy. Bret's strand ends in a unique-animal hunt (Fair Game).
tips: Finish 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks
Each strand's final mission is a trophy
Strands stay open in free roam

stages.name: Activities — races, ranges, stunts
stages.text: The biggest grind block. Try all 9 activity types once (Master of None): fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, a race win, a stunt. Then: 250 stunts (300 for 100%), 42 shooting-range golds across Griffin and Rodgers Ranch, a Top Fun drone race win at all 14 locations, wins at 20 different race locations, 50 Challenges, a fishing win over Cal, one arcade game, a bowling game, and 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.
tips: Track the 9 activity types in Progress > Activities
Stunt jumps are the fastest stunts
Gold the ranges one at a time

stages.name: Robberies — with your partner
stages.text: Robberies are a partner affair: lose a 4-star wanted level together, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing the heat, slip a jewelry store unseen, hit an armored truck, rob 5 bank vaults, and take one illegal operation from each gang. Marked Bills from these jobs launder through your contacts toward $250,000 (Dime on the Dollar) and the 100% fencing totals.
tips: Pick shops close together for Retail Therapy
Plan the jewelry store quietly
Launder Marked Bills as you go

stages.name: Collectibles & exploration
stages.text: Sweep Leonida: WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, 3 card sets, every area explored, and meditation at all 18 spots (with both characters where possible). Along the way, spend $100,000 in shops, buy every garage, and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
tips: Scan everything you pass with WAiNK
Meditate with both characters at each spot
Vary your rides to find new vehicles

stages.name: 100% + Platinum
stages.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist to the end: 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, all 42 range golds and 42 drone time trials, 30 of 40 race wins, 15 of 18 meditation spots with both characters. That earns A Long Road, and with the last stragglers — the odd one-offs and the four still-unconfirmed trophies, once guides confirm them — the Platinum, Vice Got a Price!, is yours.
tips: Only 70 of 80 Challenges are needed
The checklist appears after the story
Check the unconfirmed four again before the final push

title: Leonida Ledger — Roadmap to the Platinum
